info.cls_ename: Department of Fiber and Composite Materials

description.describe_ch: 與專題設計與實作(一)連貫式與衍伸的課程。基於專題導引式逐步誘導學生主動性學習（PBL），讓學生自發性回答“我們想知道與學習什麼”的問題？進而誘導與引導學生學習的興趣與方向；本課程將通過引導學生NSDB（需求，解決方案，差異化和效益）的原則，逐步引導學生如何展示、如何規劃與動手設計和專題編寫。本課程還將向學生展示，實施PBL是實際操作而不是傳統課堂教學環境，奠定學生尋求學理基礎到印證與實踐的逐步過程。學生還將學習如何通過使用PBL且跨領域、跨學期暨專案經費規劃等學習來促進學生的參與，並將看到PBL的完全付諸行動。此課程學生還將有很多機會獲得教授的建議，並了解教師如何成功地超越課堂，增加PBL的經驗。
description.describe_eh: This is an extended course based on the previous course of Project-based learning- design and practice (1). Project-based learning (PBL) answers the question “What do we want to know”? This course will show you how to plan, design and write the projects through the principles of NSDB (need, solution, differentiation and benefit). This course will also show you the step-by-step process for laying the groundwork for implementing PBL not in the traditional classroom environment. The students will learn how to promote student engagement through the use of PBL and will get to see PBL in action. The student will also have the large opportunity to be advised by the Professors and see how teachers have successfully reached beyond the classroom to add to the PBL experience.
